suite: Equivalent under conditions: VeriEQL LeetCode (every 8th case)
score: 465 cases proved only under conditions beyond the declared ones, 0 wrong
metric: Of 3,000 cases (every eighth of 23,994), the 1,791 the prover does not prove outright with the spec's own types, keys, NOT NULL columns and foreign keys (1,209 are proved outright): 465 proved under a minimal set of extra NOT NULL, unique-key and foreign-key conditions, 1,326 unknown (1,315 with no proof, and 11 conditional proofs the executed check cannot re-check (not scored: 7 rest on a composite foreign key it cannot impose, 4 hold only when a column is NOT NULL and make both queries constant on every test database)).
correctness: 0 wrong, 0 crashed: every conditional proof passed the executed counterexample search with its conditions added to the spec (300 databases, then 300 wider ones) with no difference; the prover loses each proof when any one condition is dropped; 181 are separated by a database that breaks the conditions
caveats: A sample, not the whole set (3,000 of 23,994 cases). Proof under assumed conditions beyond the declared ones. No held-out split reserved; the harness was developed against Singh dev pairs and an early 80-case sample (tuned on test). Conditions beyond the spec are rarer than on the Singh pairs because the declared keys already carry what the prover can use. Measured 2026-11-12 on commit 395b5c1 (hardest-cases batch 3, Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 20), with main 0e94662 measured the same way on the same sample as the baseline (879 outright, 335 conditional, 1,781 unknown, 5 not re-checkable): no pair moved the other way; 50 unknown pairs became outright proofs, 39 unknown pairs conditional, and two pairs that a database separated before (they differ only on a row whose column is NULL) now read as conditional on that column being NOT NULL and are not re-checkable. On the first measurement (2026-10-04) the count was 297. Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on 9dadccb, the fourth and fifth hardest-cases batches (Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 38) on main 2cf0154: 1,196 outright, 413 conditional, 1,380 unknown, 11 not re-checkable, 0 wrong. Main's prover (711a01b) measured the same way on the same sample: 1,189 outright, 379 conditional, 1,422 unknown, 10 not re-checkable; the distance from the 374 recorded on 2026-11-12 comes from rule batches merged in between and was not traced here. Compared case by case with that run: 36 unknown cases became conditional, 5 unknown cases and 2 conditional ones became outright proofs, 1 unknown case became a conditional proof that is not re-checkable (not scored), 4 conditional proofs name a different minimal set, and no proof is lost. 23 of the 36 read the sales table, 4 the insurance table, and the rest salesperson, orders, views and employee tables. The 413 use 593 conditions (456 NOT NULL, 120 unique, 17 foreign key); conditions per proof 1 to 6 (289, 87, 25, 7, 3, 2 proofs). The batches' rules were written on development pairs of the Singh conditional eval, which holds some of the same LeetCode problems; this sample was run for scoring and its cases were not read. Measured on 9dadccb, before main's date fix for counterexamples (b8df3d5) was merged. Rerun later on 2026-11-17 on 7945aa7 (the sixth batch, Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 40, on main edb3ae3, which holds the date fix): every one of the 3,000 cases has the same verdict and the same conditions, and all 413 passed the executed search again. The sixth batch's rule fired in this sample and moved nothing. Re-measured on 2026-11-18 on b39b665 (the seventh batch, Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 41, on main caee6e3): 1,197 outright, 430 conditional, 1,362 unknown, 11 not re-checkable, 0 wrong. Compared case by case with the run on 7945aa7: 17 unknown cases became conditional and 1 became an outright proof, the other 2,982 have the same verdict and the same conditions, and no proof is lost. The batch's rule reads a declared or assumed foreign key as "the referenced row is there", and this sample's specs declare foreign keys, so it also acts on them: 15 of the 17 name a foreign key beyond the spec (12 of them from the product table to the sales table, "every product has a sale") and 2 name only a NOT NULL column beside a foreign key the spec declares. All 430 passed the executed search (300 databases, then 300 wider ones). The 430 use 643 conditions (490 NOT NULL, 121 unique, 32 foreign key); conditions per proof 1 to 6 (291, 88, 36, 9, 4, 2 proofs). The new outright proof rests on foreign keys the spec declares; it was read and replayed on 1,200 generated databases that meet the spec with no difference, which is the one case of this sample that was read. 2026-11-18 (truth values read as 1 or 0, issue 42, merged after that measurement): a scan of the pairs that compare a truth value with something found one case of this sample (leetcode:8056) whose pair is now counted by the harness where it was not before, and none lost; the sample was not rerun with that change alone. Re-measured later on 2026-11-18 on e203738 (the eighth and ninth batches, Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 44, on main f6585e0, which holds the truth-value change): 1,209 outright, 465 conditional, 1,315 unknown, 11 not re-checkable, 0 wrong, about 72 minutes. Compared case by case with the run on b39b665, 57 cases differ and no proof is lost; each of the 57 was also decided on main f6585e0 to tell the two changes apart. The truth-value change alone gives 7 new outright proofs and 1 new conditional one (leetcode:8056), so main stands at 1,204 and 431 on these cases (the 2,943 cases that did not differ were not decided on main). The two batches give the rest: 36 unknown cases became conditional, 3 unknown cases and 2 conditional ones became outright proofs, and 8 conditional proofs name another minimal set (6 one condition fewer, 1 two fewer, 1 a different set of the same size). The 36 name 54 NOT NULL and 21 unique-key conditions and no foreign key. All 465 passed the executed search (300 databases, then 300 wider ones). The 465 use 711 conditions (544 NOT NULL, 135 unique, 32 foreign key); conditions per proof 1 to 6 (303, 101, 46, 9, 4, 2 proofs). The 5 new outright proofs were each replayed on 1,200 generated databases that meet the spec with no difference; the 2 outside the held-out fifth (index divisible by 5) were also read, which makes 3 cases of this sample read in all. Not in the count: the VeriEQL worker rules (Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 36), measured on e75c9a3 (main edb3ae3 without batches 6 and 7): 1,395 outright, 394 conditional, 1,200 unknown, 11 not re-checkable, 0 wrong; the proofs together 1,789 (main edb3ae3: 1,609; main with batch 7: 1,627). Not compared case by case, not rerun on batches 6 and 7. 2026-11-18, the merge with main c97feeb (the worker rules, PR 36, and the derived-table rounding fix, PR 46; commit 873f667): the whole sample was not repeated, so the counts above are still the run on e203738. Decided again with the whole harness: the 57 cases that changed in that run, on the first merge (17d717b, main fab9ed0), each with the same verdict and the same conditions; and the 693 cases that hold a division or an average, the only ones the rounding fix can read differently, on 873f667. Of the 693, the 195 proofs (166 outright, 29 conditional) keep their verdicts and conditions, 466 stay unknown, and 32 unknown cases are now proved (20 outright, 12 under conditions), which is main's worker rules at work and is not in the count. No proof is lost and none is wrong.
